name: Tatoeba example sentences (Mandarin)
attribution: Tatoeba (https://tatoeba.org) and its contributors; each sentence's author and link are in credits.tsv
notice:
Example sentences from [Tatoeba](https://tatoeba.org), export of 2000-01-02, written by Tatoeba's contributors and shared under [CC BY 2.0 FR](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/fr/); some are [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Each sentence's author and its page on Tatoeba are listed in the pack's credits.tsv.

qinqin chose these sentences with a program: it kept sentences with an English translation, preferred native speakers, and dropped flagged, duplicate and unsuitable ones. The pinyin was generated from CC-CEDICT ([CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)) and is left out where a word has several readings. The selection, the readings and the links to dictionary words were made automatically and may contain errors.
